stories.headline: Google funds AI tools for teachers
stories.summary: Google.org is giving over $9.5 million to five groups building AI tools and training for educators.
stories.why_it_matters: More AI in classrooms, with real funding behind it.

stories.headline: Google expands AI research in Singapore
stories.summary: Google is opening a Singapore research hub and adding over $6 million in grants for NUS and NTU projects.
stories.why_it_matters: It boosts AI-for-science, safety, and compute research in Asia.
